EngLawName: Standards for the Tolerance of Atomic Dust and Radioactivity Contamination in Foods
name: 食品中原子塵或放射能污染容許量標準

articles.content: The Standards are prescribed in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 15 of the Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation.
The tolerances of atomic dust and radioactivity contamination in foods:
The Standards shall be implemented on the date of promulgation.
